issue.body:
This rule should require or disallow spaces before or after unary operations. For example:

``` js
var foo = ! b;    // disallow this
var bar = c ++;  // disallow this
var baz = void foo; // enforce this
```

The rule ID should be `space-unary-ops` and have options for "always" or "never". This rule would supercede and replace `space-unary-word-ops`.
